slides.title: Tigray's caretaker government: what is its job?
Six months, five appointed officials
slides.body: Announced Oct 16; they follow federal directives.

slides.title: Mandate: services and returns
slides.body: Repair infrastructure, restore health and schools, support voluntary IDP returns.

slides.title: Goal: free and fair elections
slides.body: Per Capital Ethiopia; PM Abiy pledged free elections, AFP reported.

slides.title: Dialogue, aid access, safe returns
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
